protocol.method: RAVS-H2T V1 receiver-adaptive VS candidate pooling
protocol.fallback: donor count<20 or flat/nonfinite score: old Uniform rule; nonfinite aborts in online_policy
protocol.loss: original CE; recipient hard label; no auxiliary loss
protocol.optimizer: original SGD + original StageII LR scheduler
protocol.control: shared fixed receiver/donor/augmentation/Gumbel by seed, fresh same StageI FC init
protocol.validation: TRAIN holdout class1..99 20 images/class; missing class0; full 100 logits
protocol.not_claimed: No official full-H2T/PIF reproduction; not end-to-end representation learning

preregistered_rules.Gate1: both seed delta Overall(RAVS-Low)>=0; mean delta Overall>=0.15pp; mean delta Tail>=0; mean delta Head>=0
preregistered_rules.Gate2_Overall_route: both seed delta Overall(RAVS-Frequency)>=0; mean delta Overall>=0.10pp
preregistered_rules.Gate2_Tail_route: both seed delta Tail(RAVS-Frequency)>=0; mean delta Overall>=0; mean delta Tail>=0.35pp
preregistered_rules.direction_consistency: nonnegative per seed on the outcome used for the gate; equality permitted
preregistered_rules.success: Gate1 and (Gate2_Overall_route or Gate2_Tail_route); exploratory,not significance
